subject: Confirmed program time for Saturday’s Panel 3
body:
Hi Tomás,

Thanks for flagging the missing times. Panel 3 is Saturday, April 17, 10:15–11:15 AM EDT, in Spanish, at Larkin Auditorium (14 Hollis Lane, Cambridge). Please arrive at 9:45 AM for the moderator call. The logistics packet is meant to include the timed program; we’ll check the copy you received.

Best,
Antara Conference Team
policy_refs: The full program with times is attached to every logistics email as `program_antara_2027.pdf`. / El programa completo con horarios va adjunto como `program_antara_2027.pdf`.
Call time: speakers arrive at the venue **30 minutes before** their session. / Los speakers llegan **30 minutos antes** de su sesión.
Session language is listed in the program for each session. / El idioma de cada sesión figura en el programa.
send_blocked_reasons: Speaker has an open human decision.
